segment.source:
::The officer is taken aback by your feminine appearance. His countenance exhibits strong disfavor, disgust even, while his voice instantly becomes a tool of utmost rebuke.::
Schta kurglednovnemnt uniformechna zhena!? Kakva glustopdniszna che gi trudnava gle pordrkne!?<end>
segment.target:
::The officer is taken aback by your feminine appearance. His countenance exhibits strong disfavor, disgust even, while his voice instantly becomes a tool of utmost rebuke.::
Schta kurglednovnemnt uniformechna zhena!? Kakva glustopdniszna che gi trudnava gle pordrkne!?<end>

segment.source: ::Undo the top button of your uniform.::<end>
segment.target: ::Undo the top button of your uniform.::<end>

segment.source: Sagledaschnlka! Sagledaschnlka u baszi! Razbuna! RAZBUNA!<end>
segment.target: Sagledaschnlka! Sagledaschnlka u baszi! Razbuna! RAZBUNA!<end>

segment.source: You don't like uniformed women, eh?<end>
segment.target: You don't like uniformed women, eh?<end>

segment.source:
::His eyes widen.::
Sagledaschnlka! Razbuna! RAZBUNA! Trebam chukipay!<end>
segment.target:
::His eyes widen.::
Sagledaschnlka! Razbuna! RAZBUNA! Trebam chukipay!<end>

segment.source: Schta je bilo, komvarische bojnik? Schto ste nagrdni?<end>
segment.target: Schta je bilo, komvarische bojnik? Schto ste nagrdni?<end>

segment.source: ::He salutes you back and turns away.::<end>
segment.target: ::He salutes you back and turns away.::<end>

segment.source: Komvarishe bojnik, schto vi ne szlamutiratze meni? Kolotechina gu smrkla.<end>
segment.target: Komvarishe bojnik, schto vi ne szlamutiratze meni? Kolotechina gu smrkla.<end>

segment.source: Zguslavaj tvoje mve, bojniche! More, hruglasch gu strkntram!<end>
segment.target: Zguslavaj tvoje mve, bojniche! More, hruglasch gu strkntram!<end>

segment.source: ::[Persuade] Cough harshly and point at your throat.::<end>
segment.target: ::[Persuade] Cough harshly and point at your throat.::<end>

segment.source: Tebi... ne zplno, komvarische bojnik? Videm zgledam da gu opazham.<end>
segment.target: Tebi... ne zplno, komvarische bojnik? Videm zgledam da gu opazham.<end>

segment.source: U medichnestvno da gu desch bez odgledanchetz. Zluknavo drg.<end>
segment.target: U medichnestvno da gu desch bez odgledanchetz. Zluknavo drg.<end>

segment.source: Komvarische bojnik, meni protz nkuszlasch na toj? Zguslavaj tvoje mve. Ne kruschklay.<end>
segment.target: Komvarische bojnik, meni protz nkuszlasch na toj? Zguslavaj tvoje mve. Ne kruschklay.<end>

segment.source: Prkopleti sagledaschnlk u *naschoj* baszi! Razbuna! Razbuna!<end>
segment.target: Prkopleti sagledaschnlk u *naschoj* baszi! Razbuna! Razbuna!<end>

segment.source: I don't speak a word of your language.<end>
segment.target: I don't speak a word of your language.<end>

segment.source: S gluden Bojvod Trguslevnik hurnekovne opanschnisch.<end>
segment.target: S gluden Bojvod Trguslevnik hurnekovne opanschnisch.<end>

segment.source:
::The officer salutes you.::
Zvinte, ali dugleschak pislopug drndaru kreschkresch garnucu?<end>
segment.target:
::The officer salutes you.::
Zvinte, ali dugleschak pislopug drndaru kreschkresch garnucu?<end>

segment.source: ::[Persuade] Cough harshly and point at your throat.::<end>
segment.target: ::[Persuade] Cough harshly and point at your throat.::<end>

segment.source: Oprtguglite! Ja ne ostvarguslavgravao na vasch kuslasch briga rzazrga.<end>
segment.target: Oprtguglite! Ja ne ostvarguslavgravao na vasch kuslasch briga rzazrga.<end>

segment.source: Nechem vas grdonichnim da gi grudo. <end>
segment.target: Nechem vas grdonichnim da gi grudo. <end>

segment.source: Pritje. ::He nods at you and leaves.::<end>
segment.target: Pritje. ::He nods at you and leaves.::<end>

segment.source: Ne bre mi drugadarate vosnik, komvarische. Ja drndaru kreschkresch a vi zabuschdachite.<end>
segment.target: Ne bre mi drugadarate vosnik, komvarische. Ja drndaru kreschkresch a vi zabuschdachite.<end>

segment.source: Ajme... Ovaj... ::He stares at you with growing suspicion.::<end>
segment.target: Ajme... Ovaj... ::He stares at you with growing suspicion.::<end>

segment.source: I'm in a bit of a hurry, old sport.<end>
segment.target: I'm in a bit of a hurry, old sport.<end>

segment.source: Ah, nechevigni. Nek, nek, drugoslav prdzhi klumentav progranak.<end>
segment.target: Ah, nechevigni. Nek, nek, drugoslav prdzhi klumentav progranak.<end>

segment.source: Komvarische bojnik, schta sam neraschknavo liposlamio? Davaj mve grudesch iz upslav, bojniche!<end>
segment.target: Komvarische bojnik, schta sam neraschknavo liposlamio? Davaj mve grudesch iz upslav, bojniche!<end>

segment.source: ::He stares at you with growing suspicion.:: Sagledaschnlk zlichi u baszi gdulye! Razbuna! Razbuna!<end>
segment.target: ::He stares at you with growing suspicion.:: Sagledaschnlk zlichi u baszi gdulye! Razbuna! Razbuna!<end>

segment.source: Komvarische bojnik, klupoznavego u schtab prekon nesmech? Ne truglevaj na razbatzasch! Kak tvoje mve, bojniche?<end>
segment.target: Komvarische bojnik, klupoznavego u schtab prekon nesmech? Ne truglevaj na razbatzasch! Kak tvoje mve, bojniche?<end>

segment.source: ::[Persuade] Cough harshly and point at your throat.::<end>
segment.target: ::[Persuade] Cough harshly and point at your throat.::<end>

segment.source: Tebi... ne zplno, komvarische bojnik? Videm zgledam da gu opazham.<end>
segment.target: Tebi... ne zplno, komvarische bojnik? Videm zgledam da gu opazham.<end>

segment.source: U medichnestvno da gu desch bez odgledanchetz. Bez odgledanchetz. A ovd da gu se ne slivarisch trugsz. ::He points toward the stairs.:: Trgnavasch? <end>
segment.target: U medichnestvno da gu desch bez odgledanchetz. Bez odgledanchetz. A ovd da gu se ne slivarisch trugsz. ::He points toward the stairs.:: Trgnavasch? <end>

segment.source: Zdilasch hrdno. ::He watches you sternly, waiting for you to leave.::<end>
segment.target: Zdilasch hrdno. ::He watches you sternly, waiting for you to leave.::<end>

segment.source: Ali... ::He stares at you with growing suspicion.::<end>
segment.target: Ali... ::He stares at you with growing suspicion.::<end>

segment.source: Komvarische, ko si kutem proglevio? Schtas hrdne blidne? Nek taktichkischki i od strszteschki kluposlo guvanom Bojvod! Truga suzluba i gumrtzanka.<end>
segment.target: Komvarische, ko si kutem proglevio? Schtas hrdne blidne? Nek taktichkischki i od strszteschki kluposlo guvanom Bojvod! Truga suzluba i gumrtzanka.<end>

segment.source: ::[Persuade] Cough harshly and point at your throat.::<end>
segment.target: ::[Persuade] Cough harshly and point at your throat.::<end>

segment.source: Uf, uf, schto rzazrga grlce na gruvar! Neje zplno nimaktz. Da gu nimaktz.<end>
segment.target: Uf, uf, schto rzazrga grlce na gruvar! Neje zplno nimaktz. Da gu nimaktz.<end>

segment.source:
Ali... kuj si u schtab schal prementene na oficir? Djeneral Milovetche ili Djeneral Brocketznisch? Ako ne mozesch guslavasch, daj gu na prchi. ::He raises all his fingers on one hand, pointing at them with his glance before looking back at you.::
Milovetche... ::He keeps only one finger raised.:: ili Brocketznisch? ::He keeps two fingers raised.::<end>
segment.target:
Ali... kuj si u schtab schal prementene na oficir? Djeneral Milovetche ili Djeneral Brocketznisch? Ako ne mozesch guslavasch, daj gu na prchi. ::He raises all his fingers on one hand, pointing at them with his glance before looking back at you.::
Milovetche... ::He keeps only one finger raised.:: ili Brocketznisch? ::He keeps two fingers raised.::<end>

segment.source: Nischte, aj rzazrgaj na medichnestvno a ne si vde grzasch ki napolen kruslav golem. ::He laughs.::<end>
segment.target: Nischte, aj rzazrgaj na medichnestvno a ne si vde grzasch ki napolen kruslav golem. ::He laughs.::<end>

segment.source: Rad i boj, komvarisch - i hrevlje u tvoju guszknu. ::He salutes you with a smile.::<end>
segment.target: Rad i boj, komvarisch - i hrevlje u tvoju guszknu. ::He salutes you with a smile.::<end>

segment.source: Ma staj... ti to krljasch hudren-- Chek, chek...<end>
segment.target: Ma staj... ti to krljasch hudren-- Chek, chek...<end>

segment.source: Komvarische, ne mi truklavisch brugdesznu da gi glosnisch? Ko si kutem proglevio? Chek, chek... Pa ti...<end>
segment.target: Komvarische, ne mi truklavisch brugdesznu da gi glosnisch? Ko si kutem proglevio? Chek, chek... Pa ti...<end>

segment.source: Komvarische, dete suntze glosnisch? Ko si kutem proglevio? Chek, chek... Pa ti...<end>
segment.target: Komvarische, dete suntze glosnisch? Ko si kutem proglevio? Chek, chek... Pa ti...<end>

segment.source: ::Salute him back and be on your way.::<end>
segment.target: ::Salute him back and be on your way.::<end>
